form.label: Setup
form.description: Store the TypeSafe API key for the | jev command, run the self-test, adjust the settings, and try the three question types.

div.p: Create a key at console.typesafe.ai. It is stored encrypted in Splunk's credential store (storage/passwords, realm jev_for_splunk, user typesafe_api_key); saving it needs admin_all_objects. Give the people who run | jev, or view dashboards that use it, the jev_user role: it reads this key and the answer cache without list_storage_passwords, which would open every stored secret to them.

What leaves Splunk: | jev sends the fields a search names and the question text to api.typesafe.ai over HTTPS, billed to your TypeSafe account. No event data leaves Splunk until someone runs | jev; the self-test sends one fixed sentence. Answers are cached in this app's KV store without the event text. See TypeSafe's Privacy Policy and Data Processing Agreement.

Runs | jevtest live=true: Python, vendored SDK, configuration, every installed battery, the stored key, connectivity to TypeSafe (one tiny paid request), the jev_cache KV store collection, and which app answers | jev.
Saved to local/jev.conf in this app, for every search (needs admin_all_objects). Only the values you change are saved. A search can still override them, for example with model=.

tr.td: Pin a version such as jev-1.13.0 so a new release cannot move your answers.
The cost guard (maxevents); 0 turns it off.
Older answers are judged again and purged nightly; 0 keeps them forever.
Empty: the search head connects directly.
A PEM file on the search head, when a proxy re-signs TLS. Empty: the system trust store.

div.p: Every answer becomes a field. The three types return different shapes:

ul.li:
noul: the probability that a statement is true. Its sum over events is an expected count.
| makeresults | eval message="My 20% code showed in the basket but I paid full price" | jev noul message "The customer says they were charged more than they should have been" as overcharged

choice: one of your options, with a confidence.
... | jev choice message "Which part of the shop is this about?" options="pricing: prices and discounts; delivery: shipping and tracking; other" as area

score: a position on levels you describe, lowest first.
... | jev score message "How upset is the customer?" levels="Calm question; Annoyed; Angry" as upset

div.p: Answers are cached per question in the KV store, so running a search again only pays for new events. Add dryrun=true to preview tokens and cost. Do not use backticks inside a question: Splunk expands them as macros.
